fusions.name: Both Ends Alight
fusions.desc: Costs 4% of your maximum health. Spins the staff with both ends burning: it deals 9 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and sets each [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Rake Out the Coals
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health, a threshold that rises with each rank. Rakes the burning end of the staff through the target: it deals 18 damage and consumes every affliction on it, adding 1.8 times their remaining damage to the hit.

fusions.name: Line in the Ash
fusions.desc: Drags the burning end of the staff across the ground to draw a line 5 tiles long that burns for 10 seconds. It deals 4 damage to anything that crosses it and sets it [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Torchbearer
fusions.desc: At night, with the head of the staff lit, you deal 12% more damage.
